source.title: Titanium Powder repeatable quest 14103 — original WotLK exchange

notes: Historical Wrath quest 14103 at Timothy Jones, Dalaran, requires 10 Titanium Powder (46849) for one Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Token (historical item 41596). Current versions may represent token as currency ID 61 rather than item, and present-day quest/vendor availability is NOT verified. Official October 6, 2022 Blizzard hotfix specifically gated this redemption in Wrath Classic until patch 3.4.2. This is a deterministic exchange, NOT a measured prospect study.
getName: Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Token (historical item; modern currency 61)
where: Repeatable quest 14103 Titanium Powder from Timothy Jones, Dalaran (Northrend)
requirements: Jewelcrafting quest; WotLK Classic redemption phase-locked until 3.4.2; current Retail implementation unverified
